facts: About 212,000 people (2022) in an area of 1.9 km²
Built on a central island, with the airport on neighbouring Hulhulé
worth_knowing: Traditionally called the King's Island, it was where the ancient royal dynasties ruled. The whole country is named after it: "Maldives" means "the islands (dives) of Malé".
